دُعَابَةٌ A jesting, or joking; (S, Msb;) such as is deemed pleasing, or facetious: (Msb:) or play, or sport; (A, K;) as also ↓ دُعْبُبٌ : (K:) both of which words are also used as inf. ns.: and the latter is also used as an epithet; [as explained below, voce دَاعِبٌ;] app. in an intensive sense [because originally an inf. n.]. (MF.) And Speech that causes laughter. (Har p. 18.) ―
-b2- Also Stupidity, or foolishness. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also دُعْبُوبٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
